description: The line plot illustrates the similarity across different layers for four conditions: en&en, en&es, en&el, and en&bn. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and features a linear scale with tick marks ranging from 0 to 22 at regular intervals of 2, though the plotted data extends to layer 23. The y-axis is labeled "Similarity" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 0.45, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.05. The plot contains four solid lines without markers. The red line, representing "en&en", begins at approximately 0.07 at layer 0, rises to a sharp peak of roughly 0.26 at layer 6, drops and forms a broader peak of about 0.18 at layer 12, declines to a low of 0.08 at layer 20, and then sharply increases to end at approximately 0.43 at layer 23. The light blue line, representing "en&es", starts at roughly 0.06 at layer 0, peaks at approximately 0.24 at layer 6, forms a broad peak of about 0.17 at layer 12, decreases to 0.05 at layer 20, and spikes to end at roughly 0.27 at layer 23. The green line, representing "en&el", begins at approximately 0.04 at layer 0, reaches a peak of about 0.15 at layer 6, forms another peak of roughly 0.15 at layer 12, drops to a low of 0.04 between layers 18 and 20, and sharply rises to end at approximately 0.30 at layer 23. Finally, the pink line, representing "en&bn", starts at roughly 0.03 at layer 0, peaks at approximately 0.14 at layer 6, forms a broad peak of about 0.14 at layer 12, declines to 0.04 between layers 18 and 20, and spikes to end at roughly 0.29 at layer 23.
